nodes.basis: B2 CR-B2-07: keep 0.4 (XFOIL section -0.38 at Re 3e5, CL-B2-CLMIN-2D); a larger magnitude raises the negative stall line, so 0.4 is the conservative pick

nodes.text: Derived gust velocity at VD = 0.5 x the VC value

nodes.text: Roll elevon deflection at VD as a fraction of the full travel; full travel up to VA
nodes.basis: requirements.vd_ms note (D-29, CR-C1-15) and FAR 23.455 (aileron 1/3 at VD); F4 enforces the schedule in every mode (forwarded by A1)

nodes.title: Crush efficiency 0.5
nodes.text: Energy absorbed / (peak force x stroke) of a foot, foam pad or contact

nodes.title: Rotor lift 2/3 W at touchdown
nodes.text: Thrust still acting at touchdown, fraction of weight
nodes.basis: FAR 23.473(b); ArduPilot keeps throttle until the land detector trips

nodes.title: Ground friction 0.7 (neoprene pad on the landing mat)
nodes.text: Side load / vertical load at a foot
nodes.basis: CHANGE-LOG D-30 and CR-C5-09: flight-card rule S1 puts every fin-tip landing on the mat, so the friction is D5's neoprene pad value (ASM-D5-PAD-MU 0.7, UNVERIFIED until H1's pad pull test). Was 0.5 (grass) at C1-R2; the higher value raises L4/L5 side loads by 40 %; it also sets the parked-stance slide check (higher = less margin needed)

nodes.title: Upper-foot cartridge bias 1.077
nodes.text: Upper (pod-side) foot plateau / mean foot plateau; the lower feet carry 2 - bias
nodes.basis: CHANGE-LOG D-30 (C5 CR-C5-10): biased cartridges, upper x1.077, lower x0.923, so the pod-side pair that lands first and harder gets the stiffer core. C1 applies it to the level landing L1

nodes.title: Rotor limit loads per motor and design dive speed
nodes.equation: T_cap = kT_E1 T_h (rpm_cap/rpm_h)^2 ; T_ilim = t_ilim g ; T_lim = max(T_req, T_cap) ; rpm_lim = rpm_h sqrt(T_lim / (kT_E1 T_h)) ; Q = kP_E1 Q_h (rpm_lim/rpm_h)^2 ; H = (m_p D^2/12 + I_bell) omega ; M_gyro = H q_max ; V_pitch = p rpm_cap/60 ; VH = max(V_pitch, VH_B1) ; VD = f_D max(Vc, VH) rounded to 0.1 m/s ; n_hover = n T_lim / (m g)

nodes.title: V-n diagram: manoeuvre and gust envelope
nodes.equation: Vs = sqrt(2W/(rho S CLmax)); VA = Vs sqrt(n+); a = CL_alpha (B2 AVL); mu = 2(W/S)/(rho c a g); kg = 0.88mu/(5.3+mu); dn = kg rho U V a / (2 W/S); n_gust = min(stall line, 1 +/- dn), U = Ude_C to VC then linear to f Ude_C at VD; VD = max(VD_req, VD_C1); design n = max(requirement, gust)

nodes.title: Landing, wingtip strike, tip-over and stance-in-wind loads
nodes.equation: feet (constant-force cartridge, eta_f): n_L = v^2/(2 g eta_f s) + 1 - L/W at s = s_min (requirement) and s = foot height (bound) ; s_req = v^2 / (2 g eta_f (n_target - 1 + L/W)) ; F_foot at n_target = m_eff g (n_target - 1 + L/W) + (1 - L/W) W/4 with m_eff = 1/(1/m + (r x n).I^-1.(r x n)) ; level upper foot x bias ; wingtip strike roll = atan(foot / (b/2 - y_fin)) ; foot_req = (b/2 - y_fin) tan(attitude) ; tip-over: KE = m g r (1 - cos(phi0 + theta_c)) ; F = KE / (eta s) ; stance wind: q S CD h = W d

nodes.title: Crash factor and pack retention load
nodes.equation: n_c = v^2 / (2 g s) ; F_pack = m_pack_max n_c g (ultimate, emergency)

nodes.title: Box drop load factor
Load envelope over every case and both mass configurations
nodes.equation: per case: a = F/m, alpha = I^-1 M_cg ; cut load = sum over the outboard part of (applied + m (g - a - alpha x r)) ; envelope = max over cases F, H, T, L1-L5, G and mass configs MC-C, MC-P ; ultimate = SF x limit ; joints x fitting factor ; transport n_allow = n_T x min(envelope / transport) ; s_req = h / (eta (n_allow - 1))
